cross_views.interpretation: Same selection policy, not automatically the same selected layers/stopping budget; fixed last/fusion_fixed/joint_fixed provide cleaner pooling checks

A_budget_context.scope: A-only inner dev; not B or formal holdout evidence

limitations: Exploratory contrasts nominated after BASE results; the primary inner-dev threshold rule remains unchanged.
Paired group intervals are conditional on the one A adapter, fixed groups and fitted heads; no fitting/seed/dataset-shift variance.
Difference of gains uses the four systems' row-aligned correctness differences in the same group draws; two separate CIs are never subtracted.
A smaller adapted absolute gain can follow from fewer remaining errors; compare baseline-error-normalized rescue and net gain.
Selected/best layer choices and actual dev-triggered epoch budgets can differ across views; this is not pure pooling/representation attribution.
When best equals the highest selected layer, selected and selected_anchor are equivalent, not an anchor intervention.
Fixed anchors can add a fifth distinct layer; joint and residual MLP fusion are different function families/capacities.
A selected its best checkpoint at the final registered epoch while dev loss was improving; insufficient adaptation budget or last-layer objective bias remains possible.
BCE/Brier/AUROC are descriptive here; accuracy/F1 CIs do not certify every data label, optimization choice or pipeline component.
